tweets.text:
I’m incredibly confident on the fact we’re early in this bull market.

At the same time - I think that’s as good of a reason as any to not touch leverage here.

Why?

There’s enough upside in just holding quality spot bags that you don’t need the additional risk of opening a long.

“But I feel sidelined because I don’t have the spot bags I wish I did and longing gives me extra exposure.”

I understand the feeling bros, trust me I do.

But let me tell you this from experience - limited exposure is better than no exposure.

The market could easily have another wick lower before the next leg up, and if it does - there’s a decent chance you sideline yourself completely.

The more patient you are, the more opportunities you’ll have.

A real bull market will print money for you without taking on the additional risk.

Don’t let greed win.

Just food for thought from an old plumber.
